notes.title: Carnival is over!
notes.content:
[h2]Heeey, Mimosaaaaaas! [/h2]

Carnival is over in Brazil ːsteamsadː Did you have fun? Then come check out Mooh’s little parade to see what’s new from February!  

[h3]Planet 2 & 3[/h3]

Planet 2 got a brand-new Frozen Wind trap!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/73c6d87f863a14b4a9b2a7b516b55bf0d60e391b.gif[/img]  

The interstellar fashion squad visited Planet 3 and is making some changes. Rumor has it that it’s getting a more alien-like aesthetic, you know? (Thanks to your feedback, so keep sharing your thoughts!).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/826f39e232b483eb1150580e7b135aa9432300dc.png[/img]  

[h3]Planet 4[/h3]

As promised, Mooh’s superpunch has been implemented!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/8eb9a8d3f2734c8626a0d9e29b67733ec1238ed1.gif[/img]  

We’re testing a mirage effect: Mooh sees one thing, but when she gets close, it turns out to be something else. (Mooh’s getting tricked left and right...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/c4cf04a1944742f4114f0ff52dbac622323f8d3c.gif[/img]  

Tornadoes are also being implemented!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/077063ad86b443274841a211137246caa277fc5b.gif[/img]  

The volumetric level [b](which I’ve already explained to you, but if you forgot: it's basically the path that Mooh takes through the level)[/b] has been revamped, and some new artwork has been added.  
The explosive enemy is coming to life, and you’ll see more about it in the next updates.  

[h3]Planet 5 [/h3]

The Lacerda Elevator and the Barra Lighthouse will be referenced on Planet 5, but I can’t show them yet (spoiler alert: they look amazing!!).  

The concept art for Planet 5 has been updated, AND IT LOOKS STUNNING!!! We can’t wait to see you playing it.  

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

- The shield wasn’t regenerating its “life” due to a bug related to the game’s new FPS system, so we fixed it.  
- The charge of the super punch wasn’t affecting the attack’s power, now it's working alright.  

Did you like it? To test all these planets before anyone else, join our Discord community and be part of the PitacoLab. Join here > [url=https://discord.gg/eD4phDXv3k]Discord[/url]

See you soon!

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR...A LITTLE LATE
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Mimosas![/b]
[b]Happy New Year![/b] Let’s dive into what happened in December!  

We released a new demo featuring part of Planet 3 for you to test and share feedback. Planet 4 (out of 5) is already in development. 

Scroll down to check out the concepts and some of the mechanics we’ve implemented!  

[h3]PLANET 3:[/h3]  
- Redirecting box art implementation  
[previewyoutube=gPJeQ2r-kV8;full][/previewyoutube]  

- Death/damage/revive art for the Guaraná Mother
[previewyoutube=Haqel_K-w2g;full][/previewyoutube]  

- The crazy Guaraná bug has been fixed.  

[b]Before:[/b]
[previewyoutube=vQSyMtgqSr4;full][/previewyoutube]  

[b]After:[/b]
[previewyoutube=I_LW5hNiYDc;full][/previewyoutube]  

[h3]PLANET 4:[/h3]  
Planet 4 is inspired by Canudos-BA and we called it “Os Enterrados”. Naturally, it’s a very hot and dry planet. Take a look at the scenery:  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/230fcc156351f01c059bf01240b11251cccac2fd.png[/img]  

Ever wondered what happens when a cow falls into quicksand? Probably not (if yes, we’re concerned). Either way, you’ll find out on Planet 4!  

Remember, this is all placeholder art – the art team will come to rescue the devs and make everything look amazing!
[previewyoutube=a4s-MZTJlTk;full][/previewyoutube]  

This planet features unique enemies like worms, cacti, and skeletons. Mooh will need all her skills to survive!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/edceadef0e63d64785b8c77f4423219ddecce8b2.png[/img]  

We’re working on volumetric level design and adding light/mirror mechanics for puzzles.  

Curious? Want to test the demo? Join our [b]PitacoLab[/b] on Discord to playtest and win rewards (yes, really!).  

Join the community now: [url=https://discord.gg/eD4phDXv3k]Discord Link[/url]

See you in the next update!  
Moo-kisses! 🐄💖

notes.title: DEVLOG #1 - Hello World!
notes.content:
Hello, mimosas!

Our first update here, and we're going to share how the game's development is going for those of you who, like us, are super hyped to see it finished!

We've published the new demo, which includes part of Planet 2 so you can get an initial feel of the gameplay. We've already developed portions of Planets 2 and 3 and are now working on Planet 4 (out of 5). Next up, we'll show you some concept art and a few implemented mechanics!

[h2][b]PLANET 2: [/b][/h2]

We’ve released the second PitacoLab, and for the first time, you get to try out a little bit of Planet 2. For those unfamiliar, PitacoLab is our playtest program. If you’d like to join in, share your thoughts, and help shape the game, hop into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9C4Wh8TYef]Discord[/url]!

Gameplay clip
[previewyoutube=lZDPYLjnrzs;full][/previewyoutube]
 
We also added some sparkles for when you solve puzzles:
[strike]please ignore the terrible gameplay[/strike]
[previewyoutube=6Mv4U7RqsMs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]PLANET 3:[/b][/h2]

[h3]Concept Art[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/9e7edc637d5d501eec6c3039dd0ba6b86265726e.png[/img]

[h3]A few static background assets[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/41fffc79567240b65fc5df5568be57c7ed0e0822.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/daaf6dcaeec6ffece9f5b702b180796d1844493f.png[/img]

And hey, our cow got some new accessories, check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/d9ac232b2cf8c00c16c6cfd8ad395abefe607048.png[/img]

But she’s still super clumsy :p

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/723b55e4f4f6df389ef0d7e4ba735a33188598cb.png[/img]

Okay, back to Planet 3 – for the enemies and traps, we drew a lot of inspiration from our Brazilian fauna and flora, especially the Amazon Forest.

Do you know who Curupira is?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/54ddf60891d4436c07ded97d1d92122a8dd86ef9.gif[/img]

There’s also one inspired by a fruit called Urucum.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/2cdcb45ea85c30c8bcf57799e7038d0a9c8deff6.png[/img]


[h2]PLANETA 4[/h2]

This planet is heavily inspired by the story of a place called Canudos, located in Bahia, Brazil. Look it up, it’s wild.

[h3]Concept Art[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/049d86621b5476cb526c523329035f2ac3ce94c3.png[/img]

[h3]Level Volumétrico[/h3]
Here’s a sneak peek of how Planet 4’s map will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/b31861eebdf29a68a13090974d0bd550de3c8703.png[/img]

And of course, Mooh is getting more buff every day ːsteammockingː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059445/0dc17aae373f021c2756f59206e065c95e312c46.gif[/img]

That’s it, no more spoilers!
If you want to stay on top of detailed updates about the game or test the planets before anyone else, just join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9C4Wh8TYef]Discord[/url].
